html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · June 21, 2022

On May 6, 2022, voice HMI SaaS Yizhi Intelligent (一知智能) (founded 2017) closed a ¥100M+ Series B from Kaitai Capital, Yealink Kaitai, and CITIC Securities Investment — 4th round — for algorithms, product, team, and new verticals. ASR (dual-mode denoise + voice enhance; age/gender/emotion), NLP2.0 with EAZI pretrained LM for entity extraction, FastSpeech1/2 TTS (with ZJU + Microsoft). Targets retail, lifestyle services, public sector vs pure outbound-bot peers.

— END —
